## Figures for BLL Fiscal 2011

- **Ball Corporation (12/31/2011):** $170.70 (Source: [BLL fiscal 2011 annual report](documents/report.md))
- **Ball Corporation (12/31/2006):** $115.00 (Corrected from $100.00, Source: [BLL fiscal 2011 annual report](documents/report.md))
- **DJ US Containers & Packaging (12/31/2009):** $93.98 (Source: [BLL fiscal 2011 annual report](documents/report.md))
- **Ball Corporation (12/31/2008):** $97.04 (Source: [BLL fiscal 2011 annual report](documents/report.md))

## Five Year Percentage Return on Ball Corporation Stock

The five year percentage return on Ball Corporation stock is calculated as follows:

- Initial value (12/31/2006): $115.00
- Final value (12/31/2011): $170.70

Percentage return = ((Final value - Initial value) / Initial value) * 100

= (($170.70 - $115.00) / $115.00) * 100

= (55.70 / 115.00) * 100

= 48.43%

**Source:** [BLL fiscal 2011 annual report](documents/report.md)

**Note:** The value for Ball Corporation (12/31/2006) was corrected from $100.00 to $115.00.

- **Ball Corporation (12/31/2008):** $97.04 (Source: [BLL fiscal 2011 annual report](documents/report.md))

## Five Year Percentage Return on Ball Corporation Stock

The five year percentage return on Ball Corporation stock is calculated as follows:

- Initial value (12/31/2006): $115.00
- Final value (12/31/2011): $170.70

Percentage return = ((Final value - Initial value) / Initial value) * 100

= (($170.70 - $115.00) / $115.00) * 100

= (55.70 / 115.00) * 100

= 48.43%
